summary: Suncrete, Inc. through its subsidiary Hope Concrete, LLC acquired 100% of Nelson Bros. Ready Mix, LLC and R R Trucking LLC for $42.3 million net cash plus 1,296,456 shares of Class A common stock. Sellers are eligible for up to $18 million earnout based on 12-month materials spread target over five years, with up to 50% payable in stock. Filed as 8-K Items 1.01 and 2.01. The board approved the acquisition; no named advisors. The transaction closed concurrently on May 6, 2026. Watch for earnout achievement and integration risk; no regulatory clock mentioned.
